title: Lotka–Volterra tree-systems：首个未验证阶 \(n=9\)
summary: The generic van der Kamp tree-system conjecture is proved for every n>=2, hence for n=9. An independent exact certificate exhausts all unlabeled trees through order nine and a fail-closed verifier rejects six corrupted inputs.
author: Zijian Zeng
affiliation: Institute of Computer Science and Digital Innovation, UCSI University, Kuala Lumpur, 56000, MALAYSIA
confidence_basis: Serial builder, breaker, certifier, and definition-first referee audits passed. The no-import standard-library verifier exhaustively reconstructed 1,1,2,3,6,11,23,47 unlabeled trees and recomputed two exact invariants; six destructive mutations were rejected. A second novelty search found no antecedent, all twelve frozen citation claims passed, LaTeX built cleanly, and all six PDF pages were visually inspected.
